title: SSP-DMGTimeNet: Physics-Constrained Learning for Spatiotemporal Trajectory Prediction of Vehicle Platoons
abstract: arXiv:2609.06961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing car-following prediction methods mainly optimize trajectory accuracy, while rarely considering whether predicted disturbances propagate realistically along a vehicle platoon. This limitation may lead to accurate but string-unstable predictions. We propose SSP-DMGTimeNet, a physics-constrained learning framework for spatiotemporal trajectory prediction of vehicle platoons. The model combines multi-scale temporal representations with cross-vehicle interaction features to capture complex and time-varying platoon dynamics. A propagation-delay-aware causal attention mechanism explicitly models upstream-to-downstream disturbance propagation by learning response delays between adjacent vehicles and accumulating them along the platoon. In addition, time- and frequency-domain string-stability losses relieve disturbance amplification across both adjacent vehicles and arbitrary sub-platoons during training. translated_title: SSP-DMGTimeNet：面向车辆队列时空轨迹预测的物理约束学习方法
translated_abstract: 现有的跟驰预测方法主要优化轨迹精度，却很少考虑预测扰动是否沿车辆队列真实传播。这一局限性可能导致预测结果虽然精确但不满足队列稳定性。我们提出SSP-DMGTimeNet，一个面向车辆队列时空轨迹预测的物理约束学习框架。该模型将多尺度时间表示与跨车辆交互特征相结合，以捕捉复杂且时变的队列动力学。传播延迟感知的因果注意力机制通过学习相邻车辆之间的响应延迟并沿队列进行累积，显式地建模从上游到下游的扰动传播。此外，在训练过程中，时域和频域的队列稳定性损失缓解了相邻车辆之间以及任意子队列中的扰动放大现象。在HighD数据集上的实验表明……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出物理约束学习框架SSP-DMGTimeNet，通过传播延迟感知的因果注意力机制显式建模队列中扰动传播，并利用时域与频域队列稳定性损失，实现兼顾轨迹精度与队列稳定性的车辆队列为时空轨迹预测。
en_tdlr: SSP-DMGTimeNet is a physics-constrained learning framework for vehicle platoon trajectory prediction that explicitly models upstream-to-downstream disturbance propagation via propagation-delay-aware causal attention and enforces string stability through time- and frequency-domain losses.
